channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Khalistani separatist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun says FBI warned him about new ‘imminent threat’ to life
item.description: This reported threat comes days before Pannun's organisation, Sikhs for Justice, is scheduled to hold a non-binding referendum in Edmonton, Canada, on Sunday.

item.title: Centre to review pay, pension records four years before retirement
item.description: The finance ministry has made early verification of pay fixation, service and pension records mandatory, with accountability for officials who fail to detect errors before retirement.

item.title: BJP vs BJP? Why Shivraj Chouhan’s intervention over tribal protest puts MP CM Mohan Yadav under pressure
item.description: Chouhan accused the Madhya Pradesh forest department and other officials of demolishing tribal families' homes, destroying crops and filling a well with soil in his Vidisha Lok Sabha constituency.

item.title: White House press secretary Katie Zacharia did not pass bar exam, can she call herself a lawyer? Controversy explained
item.description: New White House press secretary Katie Zacharia confirmed on Thursday she did not pass the bar exam. She has referred to herself as a lawyer.

item.title: Petrol and diesel prices today, October 16: How much does fuel cost in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: Oil prices edged lower on Friday morning as investors balanced escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East against potential US moves to ease sanctions on the global “shadow fleet” of oil tankers.

item.title: Centre cuts windfall tax on diesel exports, raises levy on petrol
item.description: The Centre has cut the diesel export levy to ₹8.50 a litre and raised the petrol levy to ₹2.50, while keeping the aviation turbine fuel duty unchanged amid rising oil prices.

item.title: Delhi traffic advisory today: 21 roads around Connaught Place restricted from 3 PM for CJP's Tiranga march
item.description: The NDMC announced that Central Park in Connaught Place will remain closed to the public on October 16 and 17, citing “administrative reasons”.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine, Iran wars: Why the US may ease sanctions on shadow fleet tankers — and what it means for both conflicts
item.description: The US is considering easing sanctions on Russian- and Iranian-linked oil tankers to expand shipping capacity and curb diesel prices before November’s midterm elections.

item.title: Elon Musk agrees to settle class action over predetermining winners of $1 million daily 2024 election lottery
item.description: Altogether, 18 people received the $1 million payout during the run-up to Election Day in 2024 as the sweepstakes played out daily across battleground states, according to a report by the Austin American-Statesman.

item.title: Oregon school shooting: Three children, teacher killed in Bend; 16-year-old shooter dead, say police
item.description: Oregon school shooting: The suspected shooter was 15 or 16 years old, one of the sources said.

item.title: Trump claims Iran's first- and second-string leaders are gone, questions who US is negotiating with
item.description: Speaking at a midterm campaign rally in Montana, Trump said Iran’s military capabilities had been severely weakened and declared that the country was no longer “the bully of the Middle East”.

item.title: US Army sounds alarm: Why America is preparing for attacks on its own soil
item.description: Gen. Christopher LaNeve, the Army's acting chief of staff, said the US military could face significant challenges deploying forces against a major adversary

item.title: Inside Shubman Gill’s ₹3.2 crore Chandigarh home featuring a manicured garden, wooden interiors and a private gym
item.description: Shubman Gill’s Chandigarh home, reportedly worth ₹3.2 crore, combines colonial-inspired architecture with modern interiors, polished wooden flooring, an ornate bedroom, a manicured garden and a private gym. The cricketer has also purchased a ₹20.7 crore apartment in Mumbai.

item.title: Nvidia, Apple among donors to Trump's $400 million White House ballroom project: Report
item.description: Nvidia and Apple have each pledged $25 million towards Trump's planned White House ballroom. Most of the donations came from companies and wealthy individuals with interests before the federal government, with half linked to firms holding federal contracts.

item.title: Caller name display mandatory from November 1: How India's new CNAP rule will work
item.description: From November 1, 2026, telecom operators must introduce Calling Name Presentation (CNAP) across 4G and 5G networks in India. The DoT directive sets out how caller names will be displayed, how businesses can register preferred names, and why certain callers may remain unidentified.

item.title: 'Could cripple US tech for more than a generation': Microsoft President Brad Smith on Trump's green-card curbs
item.description: Microsoft President Brad Smith warned that Trump's green-card restrictions for skilled foreign workers could cripple the US technology sector for more than a generation. He rejected JD Vance's allegations of H-1B visa abuse, saying the curbs could push talent to other countries.

item.title: NDMC shuts Connaught Place Central Park on October 16, 17 ahead of Cockroach Janta Party march
item.description: NDMC said Central Park in Connaught Place will be closed to the public on October 16 and 17 for administrative reasons, ahead of a Cockroach Janta Party march on Friday. Police are preparing heavy security and say protests require permission at designated venues.

item.title: Imran Khan served legal notice to ‘Leave India’ due to OCI: Who is an OCI? What are the rights?
item.description: Kirit Somaiya filed a complaint against actor Imran Khan over his participation in anti-CEC protests in Mumbai. On October 10, Khan was detained by Mumbai Police. He moved the high court, challenging a notice directing him to leave the country for violating the Immigration and Foreigners Act.

item.title: Trump overrules Hegseth on Fort Hood shooter Hasan’s execution livestream after JD Vance’s objections
item.description: The execution remains scheduled for December 3, with the victims’ immediate families permitted to attend in person if they choose.

item.title: Paytm's Vijay Shekhar Sharma calls for power bank ban on flights after IndiGo fire incident
item.description: Paytm founder Vijay Shekhar Sharma has called for a ban on power banks on flights to and from India after a fire incident aboard an IndiGo aircraft.&nbsp;

item.title: Turkey-Azerbaijan ‘rift’: How hijab row tests limits of strategic alliance - Is there an Israel angle? Experts weigh in
item.description: A hijab row has strained Turkey-Azerbaijan ties, raising questions about their strategic partnership. While the dispute centres on secularism, experts flag Azerbaijan’s ties with Israel and regional rivalries as deeper sources of tension between Ankara and Baku.

item.title: Delhi power bills news: Now this is mandatory to avail electricity subsidy
item.description: Delhi's electricity subsidy scheme is implemented through BSES Rajdhani, BSES Yamuna, Tata Power Delhi Distribution, NDMC and Military Engineer Services in their respective areas, according to a Power Department notification.

item.title: Delhi Metro new timings for Sunday: DMRC announces trains from 3:30 am for Delhi Half Marathon; check full schedule
item.description: Delhi Half Marathon runners will be able to commute via Delhi Metro for free on October 18. Special trains would be available across red, yellow, blue and violet lines for the day. Check timings.

item.title: Maharashtra FDA suspends 892 licences, seizes ₹50-crore of adulterated food in six months
item.description: Of the 19,713 total inspections, 5,335 were conducted across hotels, restaurants, dhabas and other food establishments, resulting in 585 licence suspensions and 15 cancellations.

item.title: Trump weighs ‘mother of all bombs’ strike on Iran’s nuclear and energy sites: What is it?
item.description: The proposed targets include energy infrastructure and nuclear sites such as Pickaxe Mountain, where the US and Israel believe Iran has stored components of its nuclear programme.

item.title: Delhi Ramlila to light 30-foot 'cockroach' effigy with Ravana as ‘Swachh Bharat’ initiative amid CJP protests
item.description: Pitampura Ramlila to burn 30-foot 'cockroach' effigy along with Ravan, Kumbhkaran, and Meghnad on Dussehra 2026. While the committee president and a BJP MLA clarified that their decision isn't politically motivated, it arrives amid Cockroach Janata Party's protests in Delhi and other cities.

item.title: BookMyBai founder recalls burn-mark incident that led to Bollywood celebrity ban nearly a decade ago
item.description: BookMyBai co-founder Anupam Sinhal has recalled how a domestic worker arrived with burn marks after an alleged incident at a celebrity’s home, prompting the company to restrict celebrity clients. He also discussed changing employer attitudes towards domestic workers after COVID-19.

item.title: Delhi HC refuses to restrain CJP protest at Connaught Place on 16 Oct, takes police assurance on record
item.description: The Delhi High Court declined to stop the Cockroach Janta Party’s planned Connaught Place protest, recording the police’s assurance that they would take necessary steps to regulate it. The court listed the petition for further hearing on November 3.

item.title: Why China is producing more meat and dairy than it can eat - Where is the surplus heading?
item.description: According to a report, China’s growing protein exports are helping large producers offset weak domestic demand while intensifying competition for established suppliers in Europe, Southeast Asia, Brazil and Thailand.

item.title: Election Commission announces voter roll revision in 17 states, UTs amid SIR row
item.description: The states include Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Punjab, Manipur and Goa, where assembly elections are due next year.

item.title: Govt offers startups up to ₹50 cr for new drug discovery under pharma scheme
item.description: Promotion of Research and Innovation in Pharma &amp; MedTech scheme has a total financial outlay of ₹5,000 crore, which includes ₹700 crore to establish Centers of Excellence at seven National Institutes of Pharmaceutical Education &amp; Research, and ₹4,200 crore to accelerate investments in R&amp;D.

item.title: Who is Nina Manes? Six-year-old hailed for role in averting disaster on Flydubai flight
item.description: Six-year-old Nina Manes and her mother, Tali, reportedly heard a commotion outside the cockpit of Flydubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv. Her family and other passengers subsequently helped subdue the co-pilot after he allegedly attacked Indian captain Smit Machchhar.

item.title: IIFL's Nirmal Jain on working with Fairfax and Prem Watsa — and what lessons the IDBI Bank deal holds for India
item.description: The government has approved a Fairfax subsidiary as strategic buyer for the proposed sale of a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank for approximately ₹52,878 crore.&nbsp;

item.title: ‘Any terror act from Pakistan will invite stronger response’: Rajnath Singh
item.description: Rajnath Singh said India’s commitment to peace should not be mistaken for weakness, citing Operation Sindoor, the Balakot airstrikes and surgical strikes as examples of the country’s approach to cross-border terrorism.

item.title: Who is Alexandros Paporakis? MEA reacts as US authorities foil alleged plot to attack Hindu temple in Illinois
item.description: A 19-year-old Illinois man has been accused of plotting a mass shooting at a Hindu temple in the US after allegedly researching the target and writing an eight-page manifesto.&nbsp;
